spans.text: Oh? Looks like we meet again.
Don't mind me, Miss Stella, I've got a mission of my own now.
But since you've come all this way, why don't I show you a little easter egg?
I just found a "rift" in this world; perhaps you might obtain something new from it.
As for how to open this rift...try using alcohol to open up the other party's chatterbox.
Try locating all the drunk enemies in the normal difficulty versions of "Pioneer" and "Fear of Public Speaking", and who knows, you might discover something new!
